title: National Water Reuse Action Plan progress: Year Three progress update — Phase 65 Water review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Water reporting pack. EPA's year-three update continued annual reporting on reuse actions and milestones. Action status is not equivalent to project completion or delivered water.
key_findings: EPA's year-three update continued annual reporting on reuse actions and milestones.
Method: Annual federal and partner reporting on WRAP actions and milestones.
Denominator: Actions and partner activities included in each WRAP annual progress update.
Attribution: EPA and partner administrative reporting.
why_it_matters: Which records distinguish plans and monitoring guidance from accepted assets, measured flows, service reliability, allocation, and compatible reuse outcomes? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This observation adds one of three time points for the national water reuse action plan progress series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Action status is not equivalent to project completion or delivered water.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Actions and partner activities included in each WRAP annual progress update.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
